name: cadence_get_environment
description: Inspect only the host-configured Cadence installation; runtime starts a command-registration probe, not a design session. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: cadence_get_capabilities
description: Describe implemented experimental features separately from runtime probes and unimplemented workflows. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_status
description: Read live status when exactly one authenticated host-registered GUI instance is available; use explicit attach for multiple instances. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_instances
description: Discover and authenticate instances only within host-registered bridge directories; no arbitrary endpoint input. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_attach
description: Attach a GUI session to one authenticated instance and generation; default read, experimental write requires an explicitly prepared fixture binding. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_query
description: Read live Capture state, pages, selection, native DRC configuration or observed counters. Configuration/counters do not certify completed rule execution. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_detach
description: Release this logical GUI session without closing or saving the Capture design. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_gui_diagnose
description: Classify registered bridge/process/design/window/lock failures with recovery actions; read-only and never waits for the GUI operation lock. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_plan_input_check
description: Bind a prepared immutable CIR closure for fixed native parser/setup validation. Does not run analyses or certify numerical results. Explicit includes only; no implicit model-lookup closure certification. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_apply_input_check
description: Run fixed PSpiceSetupAnalysis/FINISH/cleanup once in an owned process, reject native OUT errors, verify exact rebased inputs and receipt. Setup success is not solver success. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_input_check_jobs
description: Page durable native input-check jobs without execution. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_cancel_input_check
description: Cancel a pending input check or this server's active owned worker. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_recover_input_check
description: Verify stopped existing input-check artifacts without rerun. A missing native setup receipt cannot be certified from absence of OUT errors. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_inspect_input_check
description: Read a successful native setup report after every bound file hash passes. analysisExecuted and solverSuccessVerified remain false. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_plan_run
description: Plan one fixed independent PSpice engine analysis over a prepared immutable CIR closure. Output is a new owned task; no CLI invocation. Optional bounded independent trace-row expectations certify only those declared values. Unsupported file/control directives are refused; implicit model lookup and full SPICE syntax are not certified. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_apply_run
description: Run once in an owned process tree, finish/close outputs, independently read DAT and verify declared samples. Never replay a started or failed run. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_run_jobs
description: Page durable simulation jobs and terminal errors; no engine launch. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_cancel_run
description: Cancel a pending run or this server's active owned process tree; retain uncertain artifacts. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_recover_run
description: Verify existing stopped run inputs/OUT/DAT and declared samples; never rerun. Missing native receipt keeps nativeCompletionVerified false. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_open_run_dat
description: Open a verified run DAT as an immutable public query snapshot after all job artifact hashes pass. Does not expand public read roots. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_inspect_run_output
description: Inspect immutable OUT diagnostics from a verified run; native MEASURE values are not parsed. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_inspect_run_failure
description: Read bounded OUT/receipt diagnostics from a stopped failed/cancelled owned run. Binds observation hashes to the task, checks available input closure, never promotes failed outputs or reruns. Explicit diagnostics classify failures; timeout alone does not establish a license fault. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_dat_query
description: Page imported DAT blocks or exact canonical trace names with aliases. Units report name conventions or unknown, never an undocumented native unit declaration. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_dat_samples
description: Read finite analog real/imaginary samples of one exact trace or alias, including the analog partition of a completely described mixed block. Digital traces are rejected before invoking the numeric reader. Bounded paging and snapshot hash checks apply. Native CSV decode is bounded to 100000 rows per trace, including when requesting a small page. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_dat_measure
description: Measure finite analog DAT samples. Summary distinguishes sample mean/RMS from axis-weighted piecewise-linear interval mean/RMS and signed trapezoidal area in stored axis order. value_at and first_crossing use piecewise-linear selected-component interpolation in increasing axis; no extrapolation, duplicate axes or discontinuity inference. First crossing may report not-found or plateau. Preserve imported/verified-job provenance; never infer circuit safety or native .MEAS success. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_dat_close
description: Release imported DAT registration. Every native read already closes its own file/process; retain copied input and evidence. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_inspect_output
description: Read an imported OUT file from configured roots, preserve bytes, and extract coded diagnostics and bias voltage tables. Completion markers cannot prove solver success or association with a current job. Not a waveform/measurement reader. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_prepare
description: Prepare a new copied CIR input with bounded explicit .INC/.INCLUDE/.LIB references from configured roots. Standard budget64files/32MiB; explicit extended256files/64MiB, both8MiB/file/depth32. Default strict UTF-8; explicit preserve-bytes retains opaque model bytes without guessing/transcoding, but reference filenames must be valid UTF-8. Preserve originals and rewrite copied references. No engine run or full syntax/model/implicit-file validation. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_get_input
description: Verify hashes of a registered prepared CIR/model snapshot and its preserved originals; this is not a solver result. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: pspice_close_input
description: Release the server's prepared-input registration; retain all copied evidence files and never touch source inputs. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_library_open
description: Copy one allowed OLB and read package/device/cell/part/pin definitions in an isolated Dbo worker. Pin numbers are device mappings, not symbol positions. No library mutation or footprint existence check. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_library_query
description: Page immutable library definitions; exact optional package name, revision-bound cursors, no native pointers. Cell IDs are device-scoped views, not globally deduplicated library identities. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_library_close
description: Release this server's copied-library cache; never save or delete a source OLB. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: cadence_create_workspace
description: Copy one explicitly selected DSN from configured read roots; external project/library/model dependencies are not copied or verified. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_open
description: Read a registered DSN copy in an isolated Tcl worker; retain an immutable definition snapshot, not a live GUI or writable Dbo session. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_query
description: Query immutable design definitions with exact reference filtering and revision-bound pagination; occurrence scopes and full hierarchical nets are unavailable. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_query_connections
description: Read bounded wire/alias/power/port/offpage/NC definitions and native coordinates, with optional exact pageId and revision-bound pagination. Does not infer junction, bus-member or occurrence connectivity. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_query_bus
description: Read bounded named bus members in native order, scalar branches and bus-entry geometry/direct wire references from a frozen DSN. Exact page filtering and session/query/page-size cursors; null entry endpoints remain explicit. pin_member additionally reads same-page definition pin/net membership using native HasMember/GetPosition/GetMember pointer identity, including false rows. Does not certify occurrence connectivity, routed completeness or nested Bundle semantics. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_plan_bus_create
description: Plan a simple contiguous2..128-member vertical bus and explicitly declared orthogonal scalar branches in a new DSN. Declare every page pin result and each entry's expected native bus attachment; partial/missing/off-bus routing is explicit and never a design-pass result. Existing named wire groups, entry references, aliases and connection objects must be preserved. No implicit net retargeting or Bundle source preservation. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_apply_bus_create
description: Create the planned ordinary bus in an isolated PCB output through fixed native editor commands, close output, restore clean host and independently reopen all declared pins/named geometry/member order/entry links. Never replay a started job. Routing completeness is local entry structure; designPassed remains null. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_bus_create_jobs
description: Page durable bus creation plans/jobs and failures; does not replay mutations. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_cancel_bus_create
description: Cancel only a pending bus task. Started Capture work is observe/recover only; never kill the host. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_recover_bus_create
description: Verify an existing bus result after proof the original forwarder stopped. No native mutation replay. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_plan_wire_edit
description: Plan a two-point scalar wire endpoint edit or deletion on a new DSN. Declare every page pin's result. Endpoint changes require every attached alias's saved anchor; deletion of attached aliases needs explicit acknowledgement. Match native target by unique page/old geometry/net, not an ordinal. For deletion only, paired guiSessionId/hostProject select the fixed native selection/Delete backend; provide editorOccurrence for a repeated schematic. Untouched different-net wires are frozen and checked after deletion. No junction/occurrence/DRC verdict. Validated release: native editor deletion only, explicit guiSessionId/hostProject required. Endpoint edits are excluded.

name: capture_apply_wire_edit
description: Edit/delete one planned scalar wire, save a new DSN and independently verify full definition pin nets and connection-object geometry/aliases. Failed writes are never replayed, and source is unchanged. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_wire_edit_jobs
description: Page durable wire endpoint/delete jobs; no mutation replay. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_cancel_wire_edit
description: Cancel pending plans or signal this server's active standalone worker. Editor-host tasks are pending-only; never kill Capture or a forwarder to cancel a started task. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_recover_wire_edit
description: Verify existing interrupted wire-edit output after proof original worker stopped. No replay or native-completion claim. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_plan_wire_add
description: Plan one scalar segment plus an on-wire alias in a new DSN. Require explicit expectations for every page pin. Expected saved paths may declare splits/merges but must preserve the exact old-plus-new geometric union. Defaults keep each old path and add one segment. Expected alias-owner native net defaults to netName, or supply expectedWireNet when an existing canonical name must prevail. Provide both guiSessionId and hostProject to use fixed native OPage/PlaceWire/PlaceNetAlias in the output PCB project; the clean control host is restored and old GUI sessions invalidated. For a repeated schematic provide its unique editorOccurrence reference. The native occurrence map rejects ambiguity before OPage, and output closure requires the native DSN lock to disappear. Editor cancellation is pending-only; uncertain dispatch retains its host fence. Omit both for the existing standalone Dbo backend. No implicit electrical/DRC inference. Validated release: explicit guiSessionId/hostProject required; standalone Dbo construction is excluded.

name: capture_apply_wire_add
description: Create the planned wire/alias in a new output, save, independently reopen and verify all definition pin nets, declared wire paths/aliases and other connection objects. Source unchanged; never replay a started job. Does not verify occurrence or wire-only net identity. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_wire_add_jobs
description: Page durable wire-add plans/jobs, including after server restart. No mutation replay. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_cancel_wire_add
description: Cancel a pending wire plan or signal this server's owned standalone worker. Editor-host tasks are pending-only; retain evidence and never kill Capture. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_recover_wire_add
description: Verify an existing interrupted wire output only after its original worker is proven stopped. Never replay mutation; no native completion claim after recovery. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_open_edit_result
description: Open a verified isolated edit output as a fresh immutable session for chained operations, including after server restart. No arbitrary path/root expansion; reject unverified or changed artifacts. Validated release accepts only property, native-editor wire_add/wire_edit, and ordinary bus_create results.

name: capture_plan_property
description: Plan one existing approved Value/PCB Footprint/Implementation/TC1/TC2 change on an unambiguous part definition. Implementation requires an existing PSpice Model type. Model identifiers and finite decimal coefficients are bounded; new plans also freeze the complete effective-property multiset. Model existence and simulation behavior require separate validation. Apply always creates a new isolated DSN; never edits the source or a GUI design. Shared references/multi-unit edits require a dedicated operation. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_apply_property
description: Apply a durable property plan to a new DSN copy, save, independently reopen and check the explicit value plus pre-change definition pin nets. Owned process tree, no replay of started jobs. New plans also verify the complete effective-property multiset. Does not resolve external model definitions or validate electrical behavior/DRC/occurrence nets. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_property_jobs
description: Page durable isolated property jobs after server restart; read statuses without replay. New jobs can change listing order while paging. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_cancel_property
description: Cancel a pending isolated plan, or signal this server's active owned process tree. Source is never modified; retain partial output. Query jobs for final cancellation state; no rollback/replay. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_recover_property
description: Verify an existing failed/interrupted output only after proof its worker stopped. Never reapply. Recovery may verify the artifact while nativeCompletionVerified remains false. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_get_property_layers
description: Read effective values, explicit user properties and display-property values/owner-local positions separately. Does not infer a full library/cache/occurrence inheritance chain or editability. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_get_part_properties
description: Read up to 512 effective properties of one revision-bound part definition in a fresh Dbo worker. Use partId from capture_query; includes inherited effective values without asserting their origin or editability. No GUI or mutation. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_snapshot
description: Write an immutable JSON snapshot artifact in its registered workspace; it is not an independently verified connectivity baseline. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_check_wiring
description: Read wire polylines in a fresh standalone worker and write an exact linear geometry advisory, including diagonal crossings/overlaps. Non-integer crossings use pointExact rational coordinates. Optional gridSize/gridOrigin check vertices in native units; absent grid means no grid verdict. No GUI/PDF, junction or electrical verdict. Limited to 2000 segments/10000 vertices/findings. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_compare_connections
description: Compare explicit named pin expectations against a revision-bound immutable Dbo snapshot and write a report. Exact names only; ambiguous definitions stay unverified. No occurrence/net-equivalence/DRC verdict; never generate expectations from observations. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.

name: capture_close
description: Release this server's cached read-only session; never save, delete a design, or touch a Capture GUI session. Scope-limited validated release profile; occurrence/Bundle/DRC and CLI completeness are not certified.
